sources.snippet: If you would like a simpler understanding and a simpler codebase, you can use the v0.1 release. This works out of the box with the old 222M model. nanoVLM is the simplest repository for training/finetuning a small sized Vision-Language Model with a lightweight implementation in pure PyTorch.

sources.title: nanoVLM · Models - AI-ModelScope
sources.snippet: nanoVLM is a minimal and lightweight Vision-Language Model (VLM) designed for efficient training and experimentation. Built using pure PyTorch, the entire model architecture and training logic fits within ~750 lines of code.
